desk_members_unknown.one: %1$d member you do not know yet — nothing can be sent until you do
desk_members_unknown.other: %1$d members you do not know yet — nothing can be sent until you do

activity_period_none: Nothing in this period. Choose a longer one above to see earlier activity.
bartab_discard_body: The tab and everything rung up on it are deleted from this phone. No bill is sent, and this cannot be undone.
chat_card_for_me_desc: A one-claim link they can pass to someone who should reach you.
chat_clear_confirm_text: Every message in this conversation is deleted from this phone and cannot be recovered. The other side keeps their copy.
chat_delete_after: Delete messages on this phone after
chat_reply_to_gone: a message that is no longer here
chat_someones_profile: Or someone's profile — their name and whatever they chose to publish. Not a connection code: those are theirs to give.
desk_address_held: a new payment address is being held for you
desk_address_note: Anyone can pay this. A contact who pays you through DUCAT gets their own subaddress automatically, so their payments stand out.
desk_also_cut_card: also cut a DUCAT card for it
desk_area_geohash: The area is a geohash cell — five characters, like dqche.
desk_ask_note: Asking answers the seller's card and opens a conversation; fetching the pictures tells the seller somebody looked.
desk_asked_see_chat: Asked. The conversation is in Chat.
desk_backup_note: One sealed file carries your identity, wallet key, contacts and their threads, prekeys, tabs, publications and groups — the same bundle the phone makes, so either restores the other.
desk_bill_with_them: The bill is with them. This follows the payment; nothing to do.
desk_browse_note: The home cell and its eight neighbours are read — about 5 km across at five characters. What was seen before paints first.
desk_busy_pictures: putting the pictures on the swarm
desk_car_picture_note: Sent with the model, colour and plate only when you take a hail, so a rider can pick your car out at the curb.
desk_card_answered_once: A card is answered once. Yours is on the Me page.
desk_card_means_bill: DUCAT: answer for a bill and a receipt
desk_catalogue_note: Prices in your currency; each sale converts at the rate of the moment.
desk_clear_hide_note: Clearing and hiding touch only this desk; forgetting drops the contact.
desk_code_cost: Cutting a code writes a record to the network; the first one takes a few seconds.
desk_code_note: Somebody who scans this — or pastes it into their desk's Chat page — becomes a contact. It answers once; a fresh one is cut when it is taken.
desk_confirm_abandon_order: Mark this order as walked away? Its code stops being watched.
desk_confirm_delete_listing: Delete this listing? It comes off the board and cannot be recovered.
desk_confirm_delete_post: Delete this post? It leaves your feed at the next edition; anyone who mirrored the old edition still has it.
desk_confirm_remove_item: Remove this item from the catalogue?
desk_confirm_remove_site: Remove this site from this desk? It stops serving it; readers keeping it alive still have it.
desk_cover_note: The cover becomes the ten-kilobyte picture on the board; the rest travel on the swarm and are fetched only when somebody opens the listing.
desk_create_or_pick_publication: Create a publication, or pick one.
desk_description_hint: What it is, its condition, what comes with it.
desk_donation_jar_note: Their code is a donation jar: this goes as a gift.
desk_donations_note: A code for a jar, a busking pitch, a page: whoever answers it can send money without being asked, and each gift is receipted as a donation.
desk_drop_file: Drop a file here, or click to choose one
desk_feed_empty: Nothing here yet. Heart a contact to keep their home, or post something yourself.
desk_files_lede: Share a file once and hand over its address. Nobody can change what the address points at — not even you — and it stays reachable only while somebody keeps it alive.
desk_files_note: Up to 8 files of 20 MB each travel with the pictures and are fetched only when somebody opens the listing.
desk_folder_hint: A folder with index.html at its root
desk_free_note: Free — every subscriber gets each issue's key as it is published.
desk_group_copies_queued: The page did not land yet — it is written again on the next lap.
desk_group_note: You must hold everyone you add; they need not hold each other. The roster goes out to each member with the board's key.
desk_height_whole: A block height is a whole number.
desk_keep_alive_note: "Keep alive" serves this to anyone who asks for its address, for as long as this desk is running.
desk_keep_someone: Nobody yet. A heart on a contact keeps their home here.
desk_keys_not_arrived: their keys have not arrived yet
desk_kiosk_lede: Orders at a counter. Every order gets a number and a code any Monero wallet can pay; a customer with DUCAT can answer its card instead and get a receipt.
desk_language_note: The phone's nineteen languages, carried over; a sentence only the desk says may still be English.
desk_line_needs_price: A line needs a name and a price in your currency.
desk_line_needs_price_or_xmr: A line needs a name and a price (fiat needs a rate; XMR always works).
desk_market_cover_note: The cover rides the notice, under ten kilobytes, so a reader sees it on the shelf before fetching anything.
desk_market_lang_note: A language narrows the shelf. The notice also goes on the whole category's board, so readers of any language find it.
desk_market_waiting: Listed; waiting for a free slot on the board.
desk_market_world_note: Six boards the whole network shares, renewed weekly. A notice is stamped with a little work and lasts a day; the desk renews it while it is open.
desk_me_lede: What your cards say about you, and the code somebody answers to reach you.
desk_name_hint: How you want to be known
desk_name_note: Sent in the open on the card and inside the handshake, nowhere else.
desk_no_home_yet_you: Nothing posted yet. Your first post puts your home on the network.
desk_no_items_yet: No items yet — add some under Catalogue.
desk_no_market_slot: Every slot on that board is taken this week. The choice is kept and the desk keeps trying.
desk_no_name_yet: no name on its cards yet
desk_nobody_yet: Nobody yet. Answer somebody's card, or show them yours on the Me page.
desk_nothing_found: Nothing found here yet — or nothing looked for. Type an area and press Look.
desk_older_edition: An older edition is on this desk
desk_payment_in_mempool: Their payment is in the mempool — the receipt goes out when it lands.
desk_personas_note: Each is a separate identity with its own contacts. A thread stays with the persona it was born under.
desk_pick_a_tab: Pick a tab, or open one.
desk_pick_conversation: Pick a conversation, or add somebody with their card.
desk_pick_listing: Pick a listing, or start one with the buttons on the left.
desk_place_or_pick: Place an order, or pick one.
desk_post_hint: What is happening? Words, a picture, a file.
desk_post_note: Pictures travel as thumbnails plus a full-size share; files as shares. Everyone who keeps you sees this at their next look.
desk_prefer_swarm: ship on the swarm even if it would fit the shelf
desk_priced_note: Priced at %1$s — an issue is billed, and the key follows the payment.
desk_public_node_note: a public node — it sees your address, not your keys
desk_rescan_note: Reads the chain again from there; the notes and the balance come back as the scan reaches them.
desk_restored: Restored %1$d contact(s) and %2$d persona(s); the wallet rescans from block %3$d.
desk_sale_empty: Add lines from the catalogue, or type one.
desk_sale_scan_note: The customer scans this with their phone. As soon as they do, the bill goes to them and this screen follows the payment.
desk_save_first: Save the listing first, then add pictures.
desk_seller_away: The seller is not reachable right now, so the pictures and files could not be fetched.
desk_shelf_empty: Nothing on your shelf yet. Answer a publisher's code from their Chat, or ask a contact for an issue — keys arrive in the thread and land here.
desk_site_check_note: The bundle is checked for anything that reaches the clearnet before it is seeded, because one external fetch hands a reader's address to a third party.
desk_site_reaches_network: That page reaches the network — %1$s. A site is served from its bundle and nothing else; fix the reference and choose the folder again.
desk_site_sealed: Sealed: every reference stays inside the bundle.
desk_sites_lede: Pages that travel like publications: a folder with an index.html, put on the network at an address you keep for the life of the site. Update it and readers see the new edition at the same address.
desk_source_order: matched to a kiosk order by amount and address
desk_source_record: from this desk's record of the send
desk_status_lede: This desk's node on the network, and what it has been doing.
desk_sub_code_note: Whoever answers this is enrolled. A free publication sends them the latest issue; a priced one sends a bill.
desk_subscribed_note: Subscribed. The bill or the first issue arrives in Chat; what you hold is in the Library.
desk_take_bill_back: Take this bill back — nothing to pay
desk_unprompted_note: Unprompted; they get a payment notice.
desk_wallet_lede: Monero, kept here. Nobody else holds these keys.
desk_wallet_lede_stagenet: Monero, kept here. Nobody else holds these keys — stagenet coin for now, so the amounts are practice.
desk_wallet_minted_note: The wallet is minted the first time a node answers.
desk_whose_tab: Whose tab? Somebody you already know — a stranger scans a sale code instead.
drawer_forget_body: This deletes the contact and every message from them. They cannot be recovered, and reaching them again needs a new card.
kiosk_state_seen: paid — seen, not yet on the chain
market_empty: Nothing on this shelf yet — the boards rotate weekly, so early weeks are quiet.
myprofile_driving_note: Driving? Riders see this when you take their hail — it is how a stranger finds the right car at the curb.
myprofile_email_shape: That is not the shape of an email address.
myprofile_email_too_long: That is longer than an email address can be.
myprofile_phone_digits: Digits only — no +, spaces or brackets. The country code is digits too.
myprofile_phone_too_long: A phone number is at most 15 digits.
myprofile_picture_note: Shrunk to a thumbnail before it is sent — it travels in your contact record, which has room for a face and not a photo.
myprofile_reach_note: Ways to reach you away from DUCAT. They travel only when you swap contacts on purpose — never to a till, a tab, or a driver taking your hail.
myprofile_share_off_note: Only your name travels. The rest stays on this device.
myprofile_share_on_note: Everything above goes out when someone takes your card. Your Monero address has its own switch.
myprofile_signal_shape: A Signal username looks like name.12 — a name, a dot, then digits.
myprofile_signal_too_long: That is longer than a Signal username can be.
pay_no_address_hint: %1$s has not shared an address, so you can ask but not send yet. Switch to Request — it carries one back.
pay_not_monero_address: That does not look like a Monero address.
personas_cap: Four is the limit: profiles only work when they fit on one hand.
personas_name_support: What this side of you is called — Shop, Market, Browsing.
pub_delete_body: Subscribers keep every issue already sent. The market listing and the subscribe code expire on their own. No new issue can ever be cut for it — this cannot be undone.
releases_remove_body: It goes from this phone, and this phone stops serving it. Anyone else keeping it alive still has it; if nobody is, the address stops resolving.
rent_area_hint: Human words — a neighbourhood, not an address
rent_private_label: Where to meet, and what they need to know
rent_tags_hint: A few words, separated by commas
rent_waiting_board: Not on a board yet — tried again by itself
txdetail_status_broadcast: Broadcast, not yet in a block
